phase: Phase 4.1 — Model Scope Truthfulness & Inheritance Hardening

openclaw: model catalog and native catalog views
default, worker, and session model configuration
fallback order and runtime model resolution

sessionOverrideProvenance.user: explicit session override; accepted independently of worker model assignment
sessionOverrideProvenance.auto: native automatic or temporary selection; not a user override
sessionOverrideProvenance.null: native inherited state; not a user override
sessionOverrideProvenance.missing: not enough native provenance; bounded legacy compatibility inference only where the existing contract requires it
sessionOverrideProvenance.modelIdentity: native session model/provider and stable session/worker identity

automaticWorkerInheritance.ambiguousMutation: no blind retry; reread native session state and reconcile

modelTruthLevels.configured: native default, worker, or explicit session configuration
modelTruthLevels.ready: native models.list availability is explicitly true
modelTruthLevels.effectiveRuntime: concrete native session/runtime model evidence only

workerConfiguredReadyWithoutSession.configuredStatus: ready when native availability is true

defaultConfiguredReadyWithoutRuntime.configuredStatus: ready when native availability is true

modelTruthLevels.sessionNativeModel: may populate effectiveModelId/effectiveProvider when sessions.list reports it

selectionProjection.unknown: effective runtime is not claimed without native session/runtime evidence

pickerMutationParity.canonicalRule: the shared AgentOS selectability helper requires native availability=true; the mutation service rereads current OpenClaw facts

availabilityRules.MISSING: native model absent or configured reference has no matching ready row
availabilityRules.DISABLED: native disabled semantics preserved; not selectable unless native availability is true
availabilityRules.DEPRECATED: native deprecated semantics preserved; not selectable unless native availability is true

models.list.view: default for worker/session selection and validation

sessions.patch.model: string for explicit override or null for inherit

rpcBounds.workerSelector: one lazy catalog read plus existing worker state; no request per model/provider
rpcBounds.sessionSelector: one lazy catalog read plus bounded session state; no request per model/provider

environment.reason: No isolated authenticated disposable OpenClaw Gateway was available; the user's Gateway and real sessions were intentionally not touched.

automaticWorkerExplicitSessionOverride.reason: Exact contract and deterministic service tests cover native user provenance and model=null clearing; live proof requires an isolated authenticated session.

sessionResetInherit.reason: No disposable authenticated session was created.

configuredVsEffective.proof: Deterministic projections keep ready configured worker/default models out of effectiveModelId without native session/runtime evidence.

sessionEffectiveModel.proof: Deterministic projection accepts the native sessions.list model/provider as effective session evidence.

pickerMutationParity.proof: Picker reads and session mutation validation use the same native models.list view=default and shared readiness semantics.

realProviderOAuth.reason: Interactive provider authentication was not attempted.

personalAccountInventory.reason: Real provider account state was not accessed.

cleanup.result: No disposable runtime, session, account, credential, or user state was created or mutated.
